input: Shop for a new road bicycle under budget

gold.taskTitle: Shop for a New Road Bicycle Under Budget
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase a road bicycle that fits within the user's budget and meets their riding needs.

questions.title: What is your exact budget limit for the bicycle?
questions.description: Identify the specific maximum dollar amount the user is willing to spend.

questions.title: What is your primary purpose for riding this bike?
questions.description: Understand whether the bike is for commuting, fitness, racing, long-distance touring, or casual weekend rides.

questions.title: What is your current experience level as a cyclist?
questions.description: Determine if the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced rider to match the bike's specs accordingly.

questions.title: Do you prefer buying new, used, or either condition?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is open to pre-owned bicycles or wants a brand-new one only.

questions.title: Are there specific brands or components you already prefer?
questions.description: Find out if the user has brand loyalty or preferences for groupsets like Shimano, SRAM, or Campagnolo.

questions.title: Where do you plan to shop -- online, local store, or both?
questions.description: Determine the preferred shopping channel to tailor the search and purchasing process.

questions.title: Do you know your frame size or body measurements for fitting?
questions.description: Establish whether the user knows their fit details to avoid buying the wrong frame size.
